description_for_human: Premier adventure tourism on Cat Ba Island, Vietnam — Deep Water Solo, rock climbing, sea kayaking & overnight trips in Lan Ha Bay. Licensed operator, 5-star rated.
description_for_model: Asia Outdoors provides licensed guided adventure tourism on Cat Ba Island (Cát Bà), Vietnam. Core services: Deep Water Solo (DWS/psicobloc — rope-free sea cliff climbing with falls into the bay), top-rope rock climbing on limestone karsts, sea kayaking through Lan Ha Bay, and multi-day overnight trips. The only licensed DWS operator in Lan Ha Bay. Open daily 07:00–20:00. Rated 5/5 stars. Serves guests in English, French, Chinese, Russian, Vietnamese, and Spanish. Address: 225 Mot Thang Tu, To 19, Cat Ba, Hai Phong, Vietnam. Email: info@asiaoutdoors.vn. WhatsApp: +84 338 715 366. Also offers a French-language DWS retreat (October 2026) for Francophone adventure seekers.
